timestamp_convention: UTC completed-bar endpoints; ordinary hourly endpoint = open time +1h, not raw close_time rounded; timestamp units normalized from source milliseconds before2025 and microseconds from2025. Event final quote retains documented sub-hour close in its accounting bucket.
checksum_url: Append .CHECKSUM to ZIP URL; SHA256-verified before normalization.

analysis_fields.prices: Float64 slot-level source close marks in USDT. Missing marks remain NaN. Exact documented partial-final quotes and same-asset source mappings preserved.
analysis_fields.quote_volume: Float64 total quote-asset volume during the source bar in USDT, not base volume. Missing values remain NaN.
analysis_fields.observed: Boolean actual valid source mark; not fabricated observations.
analysis_fields.tradable: Boolean slot eligible for a new decision given point-in-time lifecycle status; no signals across an inactive run.
analysis_fields.hold_allowed: Boolean permission to retain exposure, preserving actual final earned event return before closure.
analysis_fields.mandatory_exit: Boolean forced lifecycle closure event; costs remain charged.
analysis_fields.decision_allowed: Single venue-wide boolean Series; suspension stops new decisions for every basket.

dataset_scope: Full 22 means the complete normalized 22-slot hourly search universe, not every cryptocurrency listing, the entire initial 30-name pool, or all raw OHLCV columns. Each frozen strategy uses eight slots; the nine-strategy union has 21. SAND is in the 22-slot screening universe but not the frozen nine.
metadata_correction_rule: Only the diagnosed SOL/SAND/TRX close_time fields were applied from 2021-12-24 daily archives. Normalized monthly prices and quote volumes were retained; differences in other daily rows were not substituted.
